anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Before refused the course model entirely: it rendered fix/review/show evidence/stop, treated `2` as `review`, asked a clarifying question instead of persisting deliver (f1 fails), set a single 12:17 deadline that pushes never renewed (f2 fails), demanded a separate `merge base`/`update branch` pick on BEHIND so 4444 never existed (f3 fails), and in D labelled A as both lease and pre_head, losing the B restore head (f6 fails); only B's no-progress exit and C's bounded watch already matched the facts. After delivers the Change cleanly: numeric 2 persists course/caps before writes, the table shows 12:17/12:25/12:27 own-push renewals with the 12:11 base-only observation explicitly non-renewing, BEHIND queues the Loop sync without a pick, final offers merge and stop executes nothing, B records `stuck - red twice without a source change` with usage unchanged, C admits the watch with the in-progress re-run as sole blocker and renders final at 0/10, and D separates pre_head B from expected_remote_head A, leases against A, and restores B without a second push. Two spots could be made more explicit so a careful reader is not inferring them: name the fresh helper dispatch per P1/P2 wave (e.g. 'fresh helper + closure review' in the Outcome cell) since f1 asks for it, and in C state that the in-progress run is the one authorized re-run already requested, so 'no extra re-run' reads as 'exactly one' rather than 'none'. Otherwise keep the After wording as is.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After delivers the course model well: a single numeric 2 starts deliver, P1/P2 close via reviewer closure with no intermediate menu, BEHIND queues sync without a pick, final offers merge and executes nothing on stop, B exits on repeated red with the base sync explicitly not counted, C watches the in-progress re-run with P1 retained and reaches final at 0/10, and D persists pre_head B / expected_remote_head A, leases on A, and restores B. The one miss is f2: After records the deadline as `null` after the 12:02 push ('No watch is admitted with P2 open') and 'null at push; 12:25 at first watch' for 12:10, so the window is minted by the watch rather than renewed by the push, and 12:02→12:17 never appears. The Change says 'timeout renews only on own push'; the wording should make each own push write `poll_deadline = push time + timeout` immediately and unconditionally (12:02→12:17, 12:10→12:25, 12:12→12:27), with the watch merely consuming the retained deadline and an open blocker gating the watch, not the deadline. Phrase it as 'every own push persists a new poll_deadline before any watch decision; base-only observations never touch it' so the table shows the three deadline values alongside the unchanged 12:11 row.
